DatasetSeries.description.title: DatasetSeries.description
DatasetSeries.description.description:
A free-text account of the Dataset Series. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions.

It is recommended to provide an indication about the dimensions the Dataset Series evolves.

DatasetSeries.releaseDate.title: DatasetSeries.releaseDate
DatasetSeries.releaseDate.description:
The date of formal issuance (e.g., publication) of the Dataset Series. The moment when the dataset series was established as a managed resource.

This is not equal to the release date of the oldest dataset in the collection of the dataset series.

DatasetSeries.modificationDate.title: DatasetSeries.modificationDate
DatasetSeries.modificationDate.description: The most recent date on which the Dataset Series was changed or modified. This is not equal to the most recent modified dataset in the collection of the dataset series.

DatasetSeries.title: DatasetSeries
DatasetSeries.description: A collection that groups independently published datasets around shared properties.

description.description:
A free-text account of the Dataset Series. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions.

It is recommended to provide an indication about the dimensions the Dataset Series evolves. Lijst van Literal items.

title.description: A name given to the Dataset Series. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the name. Lijst van Literal items.

applicableLegislation.description: The legislation that mandates the creation or management of the Dataset Series. Lijst van LegalBasis items.

geographicalCoverage.description: A geographic region that is covered by the Dataset Series. When spatial coverage is a dimension in the dataset series then the spatial coverage of each dataset in the collection should be part of the spatial coverage. In that case, an open ended value is recommended, e.g. EU or a broad bounding box covering the expected values. Lijst van Location items.

temporalCoverage.description: A temporal period that the Dataset Series covers. When temporal coverage is a dimension in the dataset series then the temporal coverage of each dataset in the collection should be part of the temporal coverage. In that case, an open ended value is recommended, e.g. after 2012. Lijst van PeriodOfTime items.
